name: Itakura (Gunma, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Itakura town emblem in yellow: a ring broken at the top and bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Itakura, a town in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 February 1960.

features.role: Itakura town emblem — a ring broken at the top and bottom
